preRegistrationNote: Queries, relevance labels, metric and pass conditions all fixed BEFORE any ablation was run. Void if edited after a run. Relevance was judged as 'would a careful reader say this record answers the question', not 'which branch would find it'.
knownBias: The same author wrote the corpus, the branches and these queries. Paraphrases I choose may be ones the embedder happens to handle. This is a real limitation and no result here should be read as generalising beyond this corpus. It is mitigated only by fixing labels in advance and reporting per class rather than in aggregate.
whyPerClass: An aggregate number would hide the answer. Semantic is supposed to win on paraphrase and lose nothing on verbatim; averaging those together produces a single figure that is true and uninformative.
metric: recall@5 and MRR@10, macro-averaged within each class

arms.lexical: FTS5 only. semantic off, entities off, maxHops 0

passConditions.semantic: JUSTIFIED if it raises mean MRR on classes B and D by >= 0.05 absolute over lexical alone, AND lowers mean MRR on class A by no more than 0.05. Otherwise NOT JUSTIFIED on this corpus.
passConditions.entity: JUSTIFIED if it raises mean MRR on class C by >= 0.05 over lexical alone, AND lowers no other class by more than 0.05.

classes.A_verbatim: wording lifted from the record; lexical should win
classes.B_paraphrase: same meaning, different words; semantic should win if it works at all
classes.C_alias: uses a declared entity alias; entity should win
classes.D_conceptual: asks about a topic without naming specifics; hardest for all branches
